final: WITH u AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS cnt FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref), t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), s AS (SELECT u.zoneref, u.cnt, CAST(u.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM u, t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL AND t.total <> 0), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref, s.cnt AS artifact_count, s.share AS share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM s, a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
